expo.name: PanHandler
expo.description: PanHandler - Precise CAD measurements from photos. Use coins for calibration, measure distances, angles, areas, and export to CAD software.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PanHandler uses the camera to capture reference photos for measurements.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PanHandler accesses your photo library to import photos for measurement.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PanHandler saves measurement images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: PanHandler uses motion data for tilt detection and level alignment.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PanHandler does not require location access. If requested by a third-party library, this permission is not used.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PanHandler does not require location access. If requested by a third-party library, this permission is not used.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: PanHandler does not require location access. If requested by a third-party library, this permission is not used.
